defect: MarkObsolete writes the plain field rep_->uncache_aggressiveness while other table-cache references can mark the same table obsolete and the destructor reads it, a data race.
reason: Both the unsynchronized writer (MarkObsolete) and the readers in the destructor were added by this change, and the fix turns the field into a relaxed atomic; seeing the concurrency needs the table cache callers.

defect: The new ASSERT_EQ compares an unsigned block-count expression with the signed f_stat.st_blocks, a signed/unsigned mismatch that breaks the -Werror build.
reason: The failing assertion line was added by this change and the fix only adds the cast that makes it compile.

defect: WALDumper::DoCommand resets the stringstream with row.clear(), which only clears error flags, so every printed row repeats all earlier rows.
reason: The dump loop with row.clear() was added by this change and the fix replaces it with row.str("").

defect: The new MultiRead test uses static_cast<const char>(...), which triggers -Werror=ignored-qualifiers and fails the build on some GCC/TSAN configurations.
reason: Both casts were added in this change's new test and the fix only drops the const qualifier.

defect: Several new fprintf calls lack the comma between the format string and status.ToString().c_str(), so db_bench does not compile.
reason: The malformed fprintf calls were added by this change and the fix inserts the missing commas.

defect: ClipColumnFamily only deletes [end_key, largest_user_key] when end_key < largest_user_key, so a key equal to end_key that is the largest key survives the clip.
reason: The strict comparison is in the ClipColumnFamily code added by this change, and the fix changes it to <=.

defect: In this file the fix only removes a dead store of dlerror() flagged by the clang analyzer and adapts LoadSymbol to a void** signature; the -Werror=cast-function-type build error was in env.h's LoadFunction.
reason: The env_posix.cc lines did not cause a wrong result or build failure; the dead store is harmless and the signature change follows an interface redesign made in another file.

defect: MultiRead assigns reqs[index].result = reqs[index].scratch, building a Slice from a non-terminated char* via strlen and reading past the buffer (ASAN heap-buffer-overflow).
reason: The line was added in the new io_uring MultiRead and the fix simply deletes it.

defect: SlowdownAmount is declared as (n, top, bottom) with int parameters while callers pass (n, slowdown, stop) and a double score, so top and bottom are swapped and fractional scores are truncated.
reason: The new declaration and its callers come from this change; the fix reorders the parameters to (n, bottom, top) as doubles, and seeing the swap needs the callers in db_impl.cc.

defect: The delta-varint decoder builds its mask with ~0UL, which is only 32 bits on MSVC/LLP64, so negative deltas decode wrongly there.
reason: The ~0UL mask is in the new decoder file and the fix replaces it with ~uint64_t(0).

defect: rocksdb_compression_list_helper declares a variable-length array jbyte jbuf[compressionLevels.size()], which is not standard C++ and fails to compile with MSVC.
reason: The VLA was introduced by this change's rewrite of the helper and the fix replaces it with a heap array.

defect: The default StderrLogger constructor leaves the new member log_prefix_len uninitialized, yet Logv uses it unconditionally to size and fill the buffer.
reason: The member and the constructor init list without it were added by this change, and the fix initializes it to 0.

defect: GetOneHotKeyID assigns double results of std::floor to int64_t implicitly, which MSVC flags as a lossy conversion and fails under the default /W4 /WX build.
reason: The conversions are in the new Zipfian key generator added by this change and the fix replaces them with integer arithmetic.

defect: TestCompactRange declares uint32_t pre_hash without an initializer and uses it later under a separate condition, which MSVC reports as potentially uninitialized and fails under /W4 /WX.
reason: The declaration is in the TestCompactRange function added by this change and the fix initializes it to 0.

defect: Fast_CRC32 is now gated on HAVE_SSE42 while IsFastCrc32Supported still keys on __SSE4_2__/_WIN64 and isSSE42(), so it reports fast CRC support when the slow path is actually used.
reason: The inconsistent gating was introduced by this change's switch to HAVE_SSE42 and the fix makes isSSE42 return false without HAVE_SSE42.

defect: StartBenchmark passes &w of a by-value loop copy to each thread and then waits on further copies, giving threads dangling pointers and a wait loop that never sees stopped set.
reason: The by-value WorkerThread handling is in the new benchmark file and the fix switches the config to WorkerThread pointers.

defect: InternalKeyComparator::Name returns c_str() of a temporary std::string, a dangling pointer to freed memory.
reason: The temporary-string return was added by this change and the fix returns a stored member name_ instead.

defect: ParseFileName no longer recognizes the legacy LOG.old info log file name, breaking existing directories and filename_test.
reason: This change removed the rest == "LOG.old" case and the fix restores it.

defect: ShardedLRUCache::SetCapacity overrides a virtual Cache method without the override keyword while neighbours use it, which clang rejects under -Werror (inconsistent-missing-override).
reason: The new SetCapacity method was added by this change and the fix only adds override to repair the clang build.

defect: AbortIO calls io_uring_prep_cancel(sqe, posix_handle, 0), which does not compile against liburing versions whose prep_cancel takes a __u64 user_data.
reason: The call was added in this change's AbortIO implementation and the fix changes its argument; the error depends on the liburing header.

defect: The trivial-move loop over all input levels deletes each file from c->level() instead of its own level l, leaving files from other levels duplicated.
reason: The multi-level loop with DeleteFile(c->level(), ...) was written in this change and the fix uses c->level(l).

defect: InstallMemtableFlushResults commits only one batch of completed flushes; flushes that finish while LogAndApply releases the mutex are skipped by the other thread and never committed.
reason: This change removed the outer re-checking loop of the old code, and the fix restores a retry loop around the batch commit.

defect: WaitAll skips any handle whose IsReady() is true, but a ResultHandle whose nvm inner handle finished early reports ready without its value and size being copied, giving a false negative.
reason: The WaitAll logic and ResultHandle were added by this change and the fix completes such handles; the readiness semantics live in tiered_secondary_cache.h.

defect: ReturnSeuqneceNumberMultiThreaded shares one non-thread-safe Random among 16 writer threads, a data race.
reason: The shared Random captured by reference was added in this new test and the fix gives each thread its own Random.

defect: The public header include/rocksdb/utilities/convenience.h includes the internal utilities/pragma_error.h, so external builds such as MongoDB fail to compile.
reason: The internal include was added by this change and the fix comments it out.

defect: lookupSnapshot and lookupIterator print an int64_t id with %d, a printf format/type mismatch (undefined behaviour, -Wall warning).
reason: The fprintf calls were written in this new file and the fix changes the specifier to %ld.

defect: parseOptions reads --cache_size with %ld into the int n, so sscanf writes a long into an int (stack overwrite, truncated size).
reason: The sscanf with &n was added in this new file and the fix reads into a 64-bit variable instead.

defect: The new TransactionDBOptions::write_policy member has no default initializer, so default-constructed options carry an indeterminate write policy (valgrind error).
reason: The member was added by this change and the fix initializes it to WRITE_COMMITTED.

defect: BlobDB overrides only the std::string* Get, while DB's designated getter takes a PinnableSlice*, so Get calls through that path reach StackableDB and return the raw blob index instead of the value.
reason: The BlobDB interface was created in this change and the fix switches the pure virtual Get to PinnableSlice*; recognizing it needs include/rocksdb/db.h.

defect: AllocateNewBlock now uses std::make_unique<char[]>, which zero-initializes every arena block and forces its pages to be mapped, raising memory use.
reason: The make_unique call was introduced by this refactor and the fix goes back to new char[] while keeping the rest.

defect: The local NoopHandler structs odr-use the enclosing function's automatic constants kKeyValueSize and kNumUpdates in EXPECT_EQ, which clang rejects, so the test does not compile.
reason: Both tests were added by this change and the fix makes the constants static so the local classes may use them.

defect: The new memtable_factory/memtable parsers reset the shared factory whenever CreateFromString returns OK, but with ignore_unsupported_options it can return OK with a null factory, overwriting the existing factory with null.
reason: The parse lambdas were written in this change and the fix adds a non-null check; the OK-with-null behaviour is in the Customizable loading code.

defect: In collapsed mode AddToBuilder skips only the final sentinel, so seqnum-0 gap sentinels in the middle of the map are written to output files as range tombstones.
reason: The collapse-mode AddToBuilder loop was added by this change and the fix also skips entries with seq 0.

defect: NewTableBuilder writes the mock table ID through file->writable_file(), bypassing WritableFileWriter, so its filesize_ stays 0 and Close truncates the ID away (assertion failure on Windows).
reason: The writable_file() bypass was introduced by this change's switch to WritableFileWriter and the fix writes through the writer; the truncation is in WritableFileWriter.

defect: CreateAndDropRace passes the comparator vector by value to the drop thread and never deletes the remaining comparators, leaking them (valgrind failure).
reason: The leaking test code was added by this change and the fix passes the vector by pointer and deletes the remaining comparators.

defect: RecoverLogFiles pushes all recovered WALs into alive_log_files_ whenever nothing was flushed, including empty WALs, which makes DB open fail.
reason: The if (!flushed) block was added by this change and the fix only does this when data was seen; the open failure depends on how alive_log_files_ is used elsewhere.

defect: main uses rocksdb::SyncPoint on Linux without an NDEBUG guard, but SyncPoint is not declared in release builds, so release builds fail to compile.
reason: The SyncPoint callbacks were added by this change and the fix adds !defined(NDEBUG) to the guard; that SyncPoint is debug-only is in util/sync_point.h.

defect: The new test passes non-literal strings as Log format strings and ignores system()'s return value, triggering -Werror=format-security and -Werror=unused-result build failures.
reason: These calls are in the new test file and the fix routes logging through a %s wrapper and checks system()'s result.

defect: Version::Get's definition drops the key_exists and seq parameters while the body still uses key_exists and the declaration keeps them, so the file does not compile.
reason: This rebase change rewrote the signature and the fix restores the full parameter list and the key_exists and seq handling.

defect: AllocateFallback falls back to a normal block only when size == 0, so if AllocateFromHugePage fails with hugetlb_size_ set, block_head stays null and is used.
reason: This change replaced the !block_head check with size == 0, and the fix restores the null check.
